projects.title: Infineon
projects.description: Infineon is a semiconductor manufacturer in Germany running on a 20th century visual identity that couldn't keep up with the company’s rapid development. There were 3 main goals of the rebranding: develop a timeless logotype adaptable to the tiny surface of a microchip, rework the color palette to underline the company’s raw success, and rephrase the brand language to reflect its reliability and boldness.

projects.title: Terraform
projects.description: Concrete jungles are being built with incredible speed. They replace natural greenery and damage the planet's entire ecosystem. Attemps to preserve the greenery are usually futile. Terraform is a conceptualized architecture bureau promoting biophilic design - merging the humans' necessity for buildings with respect to the ancient presence of nature.

projects.title: Holy
projects.description: A never-ending quest of distilling my own visual identity. “HOLY” is the vizualisation of ME - my habits, thoughts, lifestyle and goals. Very different from classic visual identity project, I wanted to capture the essense of my personality here. Using real photos of my everyday life and real story of my path.
